messages:
alex: Just noticed an unexpected permissions bump after the role-graph sync deployed. analytics-service SA was able to read customer datasets it shouldn't. audit logs point to a role matcher fallthrough in the new policy.
maria: @alex which deploy? commit?
alex: Deployed from CI: sha b7f3e2a. PR #4127 merged a simplified matcher that looks like it allowed a default 'read' fallthrough for service accounts.
samir: Can we temp-lock the role-bindings for analytics SA? I can run a deny patch and rotate the SA keys if needed.
alex: Yes please. Patch to apply (infra cluster only):
```
kubectl patch clusterrolebinding analytics-service-binding -p '{"subjects": []}'
```
samir: applying to prod now...
ops-bot: kubectl apply successful (analytics-service-binding) — patch accepted by infra-prod at 03:24 UTC :white_check_mark:
maria: Good. @ir-bot open an incident and notify CISO + customer-security-reviewers. Add a request to export read-audit events for the last 48h.
ir-bot: Incident INC-4582 created; severity P1. Slack channel #inc-INC-4582 created.
alex: Extra note: KMS decrypt audits show analytics-sa used alias/customer-kms-01. KMS policy looks normal but our role->KMS mapping code used an old ARN mapping, which may have let the SA decrypt certain wrapped keys. Need both RBAC revert and KMS mapping unit tests.
samir: Revert queued: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/role-graph -n infra --to-revision=3` — starting rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for deployment/role-graph in infra. Estimated 2m.
ops-bot: Rollback completed — role-graph at revision 2. Verifying audit results.
alex: Confirmed: no new cross-tenant reads after rollback. S3 object access logs still being reconciled but initial look is clean.
maria: Great. Follow-up actions: add explicit negative match in role matcher, add regression tests for KMS ARN mapping, and add an e2e that exercises SA->KMS path. I'll create follow-up tickets and schedule a postmortem.
alex: assigning to @maria and @samir. :thumbsup:
